description: Rail transport performance in Europe 2021 is a dataset listed in ESIF, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by European Commission - REGIO B1. This dataset is part of an analysis of rail passenger services using a new accessibility framework developed with the International Transport Forum and the OECD and a near-complete collection of Europe-wide rail timetables. This framework compares the population that you reach by train to the nearby population to measure how well the rail system performs. Coverage: European Commission - REGIO B1. The publisher named on the listing is European Commission - REGIO B1. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, RDF, JSON. The listing shows 2021-12-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-esif.
